About.body: I'm a full stack developer specialized in applied AI. I build agents with LangChain, LangGraph, Azure OpenAI and AWS Bedrock, plus RAG and embedding pipelines, on a foundation of TypeScript, React and NestJS. I ship end-to-end features in multi-tenant production systems, from a B2B SaaS for AI agents to a GovTech platform for municipalities, backed by automated tests, CI/CD and Clean Architecture. I've worked at an innovation consultancy (MJV), a large tech company (CI&T) and a business software company (Max Data).
